verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce issues agent-specific payment tokens and scopes their use to a passkey-authenticated instruction. Each credential request must declare the merchant and amount, mandates carry a decline threshold and an expiry, and VisaNet enforces merchant and amount controls at authorization. These are least-privilege payment credentials rather than scoped API keys for the platform's own APIs, and the docs flag the product as still in development. Missing for 10: scoped or least-privilege API keys or OAuth scopes for agents calling Visa APIs, an explicit credential revocation and rotation workflow beyond cancelling a purchase intent, independent hands-on corroboration, and production maturity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
